title: Deterministic Markdown Anchor Graph & Cross-Reference Link Verification

claims.assertion: Fast single-pass AST tokenization stripping inline code blocks, HTML comments, and blockquotes enables deterministic anchor graph extraction across Markdown headings, HTML IDs, and autodoc components, resolving extensionless relative links and cross-version documentation routes without external web servers.
